decided_by.quote: This policy provides a University level framework for staff and students in the reasonable use of Generative Artificial Intelligence (Gen AI) in Learning, Teaching and Assessment practices at Middlesex University
there may be rationale for further faculty or subject based frameworks to meet local need.
